1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.WedgeLevel
2 
3 /-! On each upper semicircle there is exactly the boundary angle predicted
4 by the polar description. This identifies all possible sign changes.
5 -/
6 
7 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge
8 
9 open Real Set
10 
11 /-- Coordinates for the same upper arm in the chord and root frames. -/
12 structure ArmCoordinates (h r a b d θ γ : ℝ) : Prop where
13   radius_pos : 0 < d
14   angle_pos : 0 < θ
15   angle_lt_pi : θ < π
16   lower : π / 2 ≤ γ
17   upper : γ ≤ 3 * π / 2
18   source_x : -r = d * cos θ
19   source_y : h = d * sin θ
20   ray_x : a = d * cos (θ + (π - γ))
21   ray_y : b = d * sin (θ + (π - γ))
22 
23 namespace ArmCoordinates
24 
25 variable {h r a b d θ γ : ℝ} (C : ArmCoordinates h r a b d θ γ)
26 
27 include C
28 
29 theorem height_pos : 0 < h := by
30   rw [C.source_y]
31   exact mul_pos C.radius_pos (sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi C.angle_pos C.angle_lt_pi)
32 
33 theorem source_square : r ^ 2 + h ^ 2 = d ^ 2 := by
34   have scaled := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => d ^ 2 * x) (cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ)
35   nlinarith [congrArg (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) C.source_x,
36     congrArg (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) C.source_y]
37 
38 theorem ray_square : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 = d ^ 2 := by
39   have scaled := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => d ^ 2 * x) (cos_sq_add_sin_sq (θ + (π - γ)))
40   nlinarith [congrArg (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) C.ray_x,
41     congrArg (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) C.ray_y]
42 
43 theorem outward_eq : h * b - r * a = d ^ 2 * cos (π - γ) := by
44   have cosine := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => d ^ 2 * x) (cos_sub (θ + (π - γ)) θ)
45   rw [add_sub_cancel_left] at cosine
46   rw [C.source_y, show r = -(d * cos θ) by linarith [C.source_x], C.ray_x, C.ray_y]
47   nlinarith
48 
49 theorem outward : 0 ≤ h * b - r * a := by
50   rw [C.outward_eq]
51   exact mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg d) (cos_nonneg_of_mem_Icc ⟨by linarith [C.lower, C.upper], by linarith [C.lower, C.upper]⟩)
52 
53 theorem ray_nonzero : a ≠ 0 ∨ b ≠ 0 := by
54   by_contra missing
55   push Not at missing
56   have square := C.ray_square
57   rw [missing.1, missing.2] at square
58   nlinarith [C.radius_pos]
59 
60 omit C in
61 theorem circle_square (ρ φ : ℝ) :
62     (r + ρ * cos φ - r) ^ 2 + (ρ * sin φ) ^ 2 = ρ ^ 2 := by
63   have scaled := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => ρ ^ 2 * x) (cos_sq_add_sin_sq φ)
64   nlinarith
65 
66 /-- The whole possible angular displacement is less than a quarter turn. -/
67 theorem boundary_angle_bounds (ρ : ℝ) :
68     -π / 2 < θ + offset d γ ρ ∧ θ + offset d γ ρ < 3 * π / 2 := by
69   unfold offset
70   split_ifs
71   · constructor <;> linarith [C.angle_pos, C.angle_lt_pi, pi_pos]
72   · have low := neg_pi_div_two_le_arcsin
73       (travel d (cos (π - γ)) (sin (π - γ)) ρ * sin (π - γ) / ρ)
74     have high := arcsin_le_pi_div_two
75       (travel d (cos (π - γ)) (sin (π - γ)) ρ * sin (π - γ) / ρ)
76     constructor <;> linarith [C.angle_pos, C.angle_lt_pi]
77 
78 private theorem boundary_angle_in_half {ρ : ℝ}
79     (positive_sine : 0 ≤ sin (θ + offset d γ ρ)) : θ + offset d γ ρ ∈ Icc 0 π := by
80   have bounds := C.boundary_angle_bounds ρ
81   constructor
82   · by_contra negative
83     have bad := sin_neg_of_neg_of_neg_pi_lt (lt_of_not_ge negative) (by linarith [pi_pos])
84     linarith
85   · by_contra after
86     have bad := sin_neg_of_neg_of_neg_pi_lt
87       (show θ + offset d γ ρ - 2 * π < 0 by linarith [pi_pos])
88       (show -π < θ + offset d γ ρ - 2 * π by linarith)
89     rw [sin_sub_two_pi] at bad
90     linarith
91 
92 /-- A zero on an inner leg has the original source direction. -/
93 private theorem inner_zero_angle {ρ φ : ℝ} (rp : 0 < ρ) (ph : φ ∈ Icc 0 π)
94     (inner : h * (r + ρ * cos φ) = r * (h - ρ * sin φ)) : φ = θ := by
95   have sine : sin (θ - φ) = 0 := by
96     rw [sin_sub]
97     have product : d * ρ * (sin θ * cos φ - cos θ * sin φ) = 0 := by
98       rw [C.source_y, show r = -(d * cos θ) by linarith [C.source_x]] at inner
99       nlinarith
100     exact (mul_eq_zero.mp product).resolve_left (ne_of_gt (mul_pos C.radius_pos rp))
101   have equal := (sin_eq_zero_iff_of_lt_of_lt
102     (by linarith [C.angle_pos, ph.2]) (by linarith [C.angle_lt_pi, ph.1])).mp sine
103   linarith
104 
105 /-- Recover the unique distance along the outer ray from any point on its circle. -/
106 private theorem outer_parameter {ρ t : ℝ} (rp : 0 < ρ) (tp : 0 ≤ t)
107     (circle : (t * a - r) ^ 2 + (h + t * b) ^ 2 = ρ ^ 2) :
108     d ≤ ρ ∧ t * d = travel d (cos (π - γ)) (sin (π - γ)) ρ := by
109   have source := C.source_square
110   have ray := C.ray_square
111   have dot := C.outward_eq
112   have w := C.outward
113   have expanded : d ^ 2 + t ^ 2 * d ^ 2 + 2 * t * (h * b - r * a) = ρ ^ 2 := by
114     nlinarith [congrArg (fun x : ℝ => t ^ 2 * x) ray]
115   have outside : d ≤ ρ := by
116     nlinarith [mul_nonneg tp w, mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg t) (sq_nonneg d), C.radius_pos]
117   refine ⟨outside, ?_⟩
118   apply ray_circle_unique C.radius_pos
119     (cos_nonneg_of_mem_Icc ⟨by linarith [C.lower, C.upper], by linarith [C.lower, C.upper]⟩)
120     (cos_sq_add_sin_sq (π - γ)) outside (mul_nonneg tp C.radius_pos.le)
121   have unit := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => (t * d) ^ 2 * x) (cos_sq_add_sin_sq (π - γ))
122   nlinarith [congrArg (fun x : ℝ => 2 * t * x) dot]
123 
124 /-- The predicted outer boundary point is on the physical ray in the chord frame. -/
125 theorem boundary_ray_point {ρ : ℝ} (outside : d ≤ ρ) :
126     ∃ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t ∧ r + ρ * cos (θ + offset d γ ρ) = t * a ∧
127       ρ * sin (θ + offset d γ ρ) = h + t * b := by
128   let t := travel d (cos (π - γ)) (sin (π - γ)) ρ / d
129   have tp : 0 ≤ t := div_nonneg
130     (travel_spec C.radius_pos (cos_nonneg_of_mem_Icc
131       ⟨by linarith [C.lower, C.upper], by linarith [C.lower, C.upper]⟩)
132       (cos_sq_add_sin_sq (π - γ)) outside).1 C.radius_pos.le
133   have td : t * d = travel d (cos (π - γ)) (sin (π - γ)) ρ := by
134     dsimp [t]; field_simp [ne_of_gt C.radius_pos]
135   have position := outer_arm C.radius_pos C.lower C.upper outside θ
136   have posx := congrArg (fun z : Plane => z 0) position
137   have posy := congrArg (fun z : Plane => z 1) position
138   simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, PiLp.add_apply, smul_eq_mul, direction_x, direction_y] at posx posy
139   rw [← td] at posx posy
140   refine ⟨t, tp, ?_, ?_⟩
141   · nlinarith [congrArg (fun x : ℝ => t * x) C.ray_x, C.source_x]
142   · nlinarith [congrArg (fun x : ℝ => t * x) C.ray_y, C.source_y]
143 
144 /-- Exactly one angular location on the upper semicircle can be a zero.
145 If the predicted angle has passed either end of that semicircle, there is none. -/
146 theorem zero_iff_boundary_angle {ρ φ : ℝ} (rp : 0 < ρ) (ph : φ ∈ Icc 0 π) :
147     level h r a b (r + ρ * cos φ) (ρ * sin φ) = 0 ↔ φ = θ + offset d γ ρ := by
148   have vp : 0 ≤ ρ * sin φ := mul_nonneg rp.le (sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi ph.1 ph.2)
149   constructor
150   · intro zero
151     rcases level_zero_on_arm C.height_pos vp C.outward C.ray_nonzero zero with inner | outer
152     · have angle := C.inner_zero_angle rp ph inner.2
153       have outside : ρ ≤ d := by
154         rw [angle, C.source_y] at inner
155         by_contra after
156         have product := mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr (lt_of_not_ge after))
157           (sin_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi C.angle_pos C.angle_lt_pi)
158         linarith [inner.1.2]
159       by_cases strict : ρ < d
160       · simpa [offset, strict] using angle
161       · have same : ρ = d := le_antisymm outside (le_of_not_gt strict)
162         rw [same, offset_at_elbow C.radius_pos C.lower C.upper, add_zero]
163         exact angle
164     · obtain ⟨t, tp, px, py⟩ := outer
165       have circle := circle_square (r := r) ρ φ
166       rw [px, py] at circle
167       obtain ⟨outside, travel_eq⟩ := C.outer_parameter rp tp circle
168       have position := outer_arm C.radius_pos C.lower C.upper outside θ
169       have posx := congrArg (fun z : Plane => z 0) position
170       have posy := congrArg (fun z : Plane => z 1) position
171       simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, PiLp.add_apply, smul_eq_mul, direction_x, direction_y] at posx posy
172       rw [← travel_eq] at posx posy
173       have cosine : cos φ = cos (θ + offset d γ ρ) := by
174         nlinarith [congrArg (fun x : ℝ => t * x) C.ray_x, C.source_x]
175       have sine : sin φ = sin (θ + offset d γ ρ) := by
176         nlinarith [congrArg (fun x : ℝ => t * x) C.ray_y, C.source_y]
177       have beta := C.boundary_angle_in_half (by rw [← sine]; exact sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi ph.1 ph.2)
178       exact strictAntiOn_cos.injOn ph beta cosine
179   · intro angle
180     by_cases inside : ρ < d
181     · have same : φ = θ := by simpa [offset, inside] using angle
182       apply level_zero_of_inner C.height_pos C.outward
183       · rw [same, C.source_y]
184         exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right inside.le (sin_nonneg_of_nonneg_of_le_pi C.angle_pos.le C.angle_lt_pi.le)
185       · rw [same, C.source_y, show r = -(d * cos θ) by linarith [C.source_x]]
186         ring
187     · have outside : d ≤ ρ := le_of_not_gt inside
188       obtain ⟨t, tp, px, py⟩ := C.boundary_ray_point outside
189       rw [angle, px, py]
190       exact level_zero_of_outer C.height_pos C.outward tp
191 
192 end ArmCoordinates
193 end SixVertexUnfolding.Wedge
